title: Welcome, Travellers

readiness.math: filling to a line; half and quarter (older)
readiness.reading: pre-reader friendly; all text can be read aloud

intro.speaker: ruth
intro.text: Travellers from Bellhaven have come to see our valley. They've walked a long way, and they're thirsty.

intro.speaker: ruth
intro.text: Let's welcome them with cups of milk. Fill each cup to its line.

steps.speaker: ruth
steps.prompt: Fill each cup to its line. Hold the jug over a cup, and let go at the line.

older.prompt: Fill each cup to its line: half, three quarters, a quarter, half.

feedback.all_good: Every cup is ready. Welcome, travellers!

outro.speaker: ruth
outro.text: "I was a stranger, and you welcomed me." That's what Jesus said. Today you did just that.

journal_line: I welcomed travellers from Bellhaven with cups of milk.
unavailable_text: The travellers are welcomed for today.
